_: Overlaps that have been looked at in the rendered PNG and judged
correct. Every entry names the figure and says what was seen.
The geometry check cannot tell a label written deliberately on a
bar from a label that has landed on a curve by accident; a person
can. Anything not listed here fails `make audit`, so a new overlap
still has to be looked at rather than waved through.
ch03-timeline: text 'decode - 300 tokens: Set in white inside the bar it describes, which is the point: the bar is the decode phase. The 'line' is the per-token tick marks drawn across it.
ch05-tradeoff: text 'the curve stops her: Crosses a dotted latency-budget guide, not a data curve. The callout has its own arrow to the point it is about.
ch05-tradeoff: text 'batch 325' sits on: Placed automatically, with a leader to its point; the nearest curve passes a few points from the box on an axis where every other position is worse.
ch07-size: text 'a 16x16 multiply uses 2: The curve's steep rise passes beside the last word, not through it, and the callout carries an arrow to the point it names.
ch11-waste: text '99.7% discarded' sits: Sits under the curve with an arrow to the top of it; the curve grazes the box corner.
ch12-per-step: text 'prefill: the same w: Well above the curve at the x where it is written; the arrow, not the text, reaches the curve.
ch18-budget: text 'between-token budget:: Directly beneath the dotted guide it labels, which is what it is for. Both data curves are far from it at that end of the panel.
